brief.text: Real estate and medical equipment dominate today’s cluster activity, with real estate names STWD, NXRT, and HPP alongside medical device firms NXGL, ENOV, and OBIO drawing multiple buyers. GAM stands out for insider breadth with five individuals participating for a combined $760,290, the highest buyer count on the board. FUN logged the largest overall cluster total at $24.3 million across three insiders, while STWD CEO Barry Sternlicht posted the day’s single largest individual purchase at $14.7 million.
